question: Supriya made a profit of 8% by selling a t-shirt after offering a discount of 10%. If the marked price of the t-shirt is Rs. 1,080, then find its cost price (in Rs.) for Supriya.
solution:
Given :

A shopkeeper was selling a T-shirt at a discount of 10% so that he would earn a profit of 8%.

MP = 1080

Formula:

MP = SP × (100 - D)/100

SP = SP × (100 - P)/100

Calculation : 

Let the CP be x.

When the discount is 10%, profit is 8%,

Selling price = Cost price + Profit = x + 8% of x = 1.08x

∵ Marked price – Discount = Selling price

⇒ MP – 10% of MP = 1.08x

⇒ MP = 1.08x/0.9 = 1.2x

1.2x → 1080

x → 1080/1.2 = 900

**The answer is 900.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

(100 + P)/(100 - D) = MP/CP

⇒ 108/90 = 1080/CP

CP = 900
